## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

`--exclude` should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI jobs can omit matching files through the environment, as project policy requires.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that matches filenames before adding them to the archive and logs skipped paths at INFO level. It documents the flag and adds parser, file collection, and archive tests.

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Default `--exclude` from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE='*.log'` and no `--exclude` argument, the archive still includes `debug.log` because the parser defaults to `[]`. Each new flag “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” (`.agents/skills/cli-flags/reference.md:5`). — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment can publish archives containing files they intended to omit.
